spanish: O ha sido conocido que buey embistente él desde ayer anteayer, y no lo guardará su dueño, pagando pagará buey debajo del buey, y el muerto será a él.

findings.issue: Noun is masculine plural construct plus a 3ms suffix; singular dueño changes the number.
Preposition lemma leaves under and in-place-of open; debajo resolves it as spatial underneath.
Qal imperfect 3ms is not marked future; guardará locks a future indicative.

notes: Remaining tokens match in person, stem, definiteness, and repetition.
